short: Oxygen-Evolving Manganese Ferrite Nanovesicles for Hypoxia-R
title: Oxygen-Evolving Manganese Ferrite Nanovesicles for Hypoxia-Responsive Drug Delivery and Enhanced Cancer Chemoimmunotherapy

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Hypoxia in solid tumours blunts both chemotherapy and immune-checkpoint therapy. A nanovesicle that dissociates under hypoxia should release Dox and catalytically evolve O2, relieving tumour hypoxia.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/modification), n5 (DES/architecture), n6 (PRC/synthesis), n7 (PRC/forming), n9 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Hypoxia-induced Treg infiltration in tumours correlates with poor clinical prognosis; Spinel manganese ferrite shows catalase- and Fenton-like activity toward H2O2; 2-Nitroimidazole is reduced by nitroreductase with NADH under hypoxia to a hydrophilic aminoimidazole

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Dox-MVs are hollow spheres whose membrane is a single densely packed monolayer of MFNs. Under hypoxia the vesicular architecture is lost and the MFNs spread as loose, irregular clusters

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Nitroreductase reduces the nitroimidazole side groups, turning the PNIHM block hydrophilic and destabilising the membrane. Dox release is hypoxia-gated: about 90% within 2 h under hypoxia against under 10% over 5 h in normoxia.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n12 (PRP/value), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n17 (MEC/pathway). Premises: 2-Nitroimidazole is reduced by nitroreductase with NADH under hypoxia to a hydrophilic aminoimidazole; Spinel manganese ferrite shows catalase- and Fenton-like activity toward H2O2; Hypoxia-induced Treg infiltration in tumours correlates with poor clinical prognosis

states.title: Performance state
states.head: In 4T1 tumours Dox-MVs raise sO2 from 2.7% to 17.5% at 24 h and cut the HIF-1a-positive area to 7%. Dox-MVs with aPD-L1 hold tumours near 250 mm3 to day 20, the lowest of the ten groups.

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Hypoxia-responsive oxygen-evolving manganese ferrite nanovesicles turn the hypoxic TME into an ally for chemoimmunotherapy

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: Vesicle diameter rises from about 120 to about 276 nm as BCP graft density rises from 0.03 to 0.09 chains/nm2
nodes.detail: o3: Vesicle diameter rises from about 120 to about 276 nm as BCP graft density rises from 0.03 to 0.09 chains/nm2
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n9 (o3).

nodes.title: TEM:HAADF, F1
nodes.head: Uniform ~120 nm spheres built from one densely packed layer of ~12 nm particles; arrowed shells are broken over a hollow interior
nodes.solves: Dox-MVs are hollow spheres whose membrane is a single densely packed monolayer of MFNs
nodes.note: F1d inset shows a collapsed bowl-shaped shell; in F1e HAADF several vesicles are brighter at the rim than at the centre
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o2 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F2
nodes.head: After 2 h with NADH and nitroreductase no intact vesicle remains, only dispersed particles and loose clusters. Inside hypoxic cells the internalised assemblies lose their round compact form and spread as irregular particle masses
nodes.solves: Under hypoxia the vesicular architecture is lost and the MFNs spread as loose, irregular clusters
nodes.note: the offered F1i crop holds only the 2 h frame of panel I; the 0 h and 0.5 h frames, read from the whole figure F1, still show intact vesicles the particles stay clustered rather than individually dispersed, so 'disintegrated vesicles' is shown only in the weaker sense of lost sphericity
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n10 (o4).

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: Fe and Mn maps coincide with the same particle-textured spheres, both elements spread over every assembly
nodes.solves: Dox-MVs are hollow spheres whose membrane is a single densely packed monolayer of MFNs
nodes.note: the strings 'Fe' and 'Mn' are panel annotations that name the channels; the spatial coincidence itself is judged from the pixels. The projected maps are filled discs, so they show composition, not the monolayer
nodes.detail: o2: Fe and Mn maps coincide with the same particle-textured spheres, both elements spread over every assembly
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o1 after removal.

nodes.title: TEM, F2
nodes.head: Hypoxic cells given H2O2 plus MVs lose the H2O2-tracker signal, while normoxic cells given H2O2 plus MVs keep it
nodes.solves: Dissociation unlocks catalase-like activity: only dissociated MVs consume H2O2 and evolve O2
nodes.note: the F2 linked text covers only the TEM panel; this hypoxia-gating of intracellular H2O2 consumption is never stated in the packet text

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: Cumulative Dox release reaches about 90% by 120 min under hypoxia and plateaus near 9% under normoxia
nodes.solves: Dox release is hypoxia-gated: about 90% within 2 h under hypoxia against under 10% over 5 h in normoxia
nodes.note: the instrument used for the release assay is not stated anywhere in the packet
nodes.detail: o6: Cumulative Dox release reaches about 90% by 120 min under hypoxia and plateaus near 9% under normoxia
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n12 (o6).

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: With dissociated MVs H2O2 falls to 28% in 180 min and O2 reaches 54 ppm in 30 min; intact MVs give 92% and about 2 ppm. Residual H2O2 after each repeated H2O2 spike rises from 28 to 38 to 40 uM
nodes.solves: Dissociation unlocks catalase-like activity: only dissociated MVs consume H2O2 and evolve O2
nodes.note: F1l and F1m carry markers and error bars; F1n does not, so the repetitive-catalysis panel reads as an idealised trace
nodes.detail: o7: With dissociated MVs H2O2 falls to 28% in 180 min and O2 reaches 54 ppm in 30 min; intact MVs give 92% and about 2 ppm; a3: Residual H2O2 after each repeated H2O2 spike rises from 28 to 38 to 40 uM
nodes.inner_audit: a3: F1l and F1m carry markers and error bars; F1n does not, so the repetitive-catalysis panel reads as an idealised trace

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Under hypoxia Dox-MV viability falls to 19-22% at 5-20 ug/mL Dox; under normoxia it stays near 90% at every dose
nodes.solves: Dox-MVs kill 4T1 cells only under hypoxia: viability about 20% against about 90% in normoxia at 5-20 ug/mL Dox
nodes.note: bare MVs leave 90-100% viability up to 400 ug/mL MnFe2O4 in both atmospheres; under hypoxia at 5-20 ug/mL Dox-MVs kill more than free Dox (29-32%)
nodes.detail: o9: Under hypoxia Dox-MV viability falls to 19-22% at 5-20 ug/mL Dox; under normoxia it stays near 90% at every dose
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n14 (o9).

nodes.title: evidence, F4, F5
nodes.head: CD8+ T cells reach 66%, CD8/Treg about 20, serum TNF-a 46 and IFN-g 92 pg/mL, all highest for Dox-MVs plus aPD-L1. Splenic effector-memory T cells reach 83% and serum TNF-a 142 and IFN-g 88 pg/mL, highest of the five rechallenge groups
nodes.solves: Relieved hypoxia with Dox-induced immunogenic cell death raises CD8+ CTL infiltration and the CD8/Treg ratio, potentiating PD-L1 blockade
nodes.note: Dox-GVs plus aPD-L1 reaches 56% CD8+, above Dox-MVs alone at 51%, so the ranking is not set by hypoxia relief alone
nodes.detail: o16: CD8+ T cells reach 66%, CD8/Treg about 20, serum TNF-a 46 and IFN-g 92 pg/mL, all highest for Dox-MVs plus aPD-L1; o17: Splenic effector-memory T cells reach 83% and serum TNF-a 142 and IFN-g 88 pg/mL, highest of the five rechallenge groups
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n17 (o16, o17).

nodes.title: MICRO, F3
nodes.head: HIF-1a green signal is strong in PBS sections, weaker with Dox and essentially absent with Dox-MVs
nodes.solves: In 4T1 tumours Dox-MVs raise sO2 from 2.7% to 17.5% at 24 h and cut the HIF-1a-positive area to 7%

nodes.title: ASSAY:tumour, CT, F3
nodes.head: Tumour sO2 with Dox-MVs rises 2.7 to 10.3 to 13.0 to 17.5% at 0, 4, 12 and 24 h while PBS and Dox stay at 1-3%. Hypoxia-positive area is 84% for PBS, 76% for Dox and 7% for Dox-MVs.
nodes.solves: In 4T1 tumours Dox-MVs raise sO2 from 2.7% to 17.5% at 24 h and cut the HIF-1a-positive area to 7%
nodes.note: the technique is photoacoustic imaging, which normalize_technique files under the CT family the three bar values are read against the F3g axis; the F3 caption adds that the areas were scored from more than 10 micrographs per group with ImageJ the F3 linked text reports 'increased levels of sO2 even at 48 h' and does not note the fall from 17.5%
nodes.detail: o10: Tumour sO2 with Dox-MVs rises 2.7 to 10.3 to 13.0 to 17.5% at 0, 4, 12 and 24 h while PBS and Dox stay at 1-3%; o12: Hypoxia-positive area is 84% for PBS, 76% for Dox and 7% for Dox-MVs; a2: Tumour sO2 with Dox-MVs falls back to 8.8% at 48 h, half its 24 h value
nodes.inner_audit: a2: the F3 linked text reports 'increased levels of sO2 even at 48 h' and does not note the fall from 17.5%

nodes.title: ASSAY:tumour, F3

nodes.note: at 1 h the circled tumour flank is blue (low) while head and neck are red; modality taken as spatial_map because the panel is a radiance map over the animal
